title: Captions never fully leave the screen and go stale
what: The 'hidden' toast is only translated up by 140% of its height, so it stays visible: in Broadcast view 'TAKATS TAKES THE LEAD' sits permanently under the race clock (here at +1:47, long after the event), on phone it sits over the telemetry card, and after scrubbing back 'VARGA FIRST IN GOAL' shows at +0:34 (a spoiler).
why: A broadcast caption is on air for a few seconds and then it is gone; a stale or leftover caption is the clearest sign of an unpolished build.
fix: Hide with opacity:0 + visibility:hidden (plus the slide), clear the toast and its timer in jump()/scrub/setCine, and only show toasts during forward playback.

title: Board order contradicts its own numbers
what: Before the gate P2 shows '+12 m' (higher than the pilot marked 'Top') and gaps run +12, −19, −6, +6; mid-race gaps are non-monotonic (+1:18 above +1:23 above +1:12). The board says the leader is at 2,747 m, the map tag says 2,731 m and 'Highest pilot' says 2,759 m, all on one screen.
why: Broadcast timing graphics are always monotonic and every number on screen comes from one snapshot; contradictory values look like a mock-up rather than a timing feed.
fix: Use one snapshot for board, tags, top bar and lower third; refresh values and order together; after settle() re-sort or recompute gaps from the displayed order (never show a negative 'gap to the pilot above').

title: Rows fly through each other on every reshuffle
what: Every 2 s up to 20 rows animate at once with a 0.45 s transform; captured mid-move, rows overlap (ANDRELIUNAS/QUINTANILLA, MCCLURG/DIAZ) with text printed on text and empty gaps in the list.
why: F1/SailGP towers swap positions one pair at a time, with a short highlight on the mover; mass sliding reads as a generic list animation.
fix: Animate only rows whose position changed, stagger swaps, clip each row (opaque background, z-order by direction), and skip the animation on seeks (set transforms instantly when force is true).

title: Lower third has an empty hole where the flag should be, and is a rounded glass capsule
what: The broadcast lower third reads 'P1 [gap] TAKATS': the flag span gets inline width/height but its <i> stripes have no flex rule outside .pil/.tele-h, so it renders blank. The bar itself is a 10 px-radius frosted capsule floating mid-screen.
why: SailGP/F1 lower thirds are hard-edged, opaque bands anchored to a safe-area edge with a colour chip and flag tight against the name.
fix: Add .cine-bar .fl{display:flex}.cine-bar .fl i{flex:1}; square the corners (0–2 px), make it an opaque band anchored bottom-left with the position block as a solid orange tab.

title: Event caption looks like a web-app notification
what: Toasts are centred rounded pills with backdrop blur, a peach border and an orange glow shadow (box-shadow 0 20px 50px rgba(255,95,0,.45)), in pale orange italic caps.
why: Glow halos and frosted pills are template UI; broadcast event captions are flat, opaque, square-cut strips (e.g. black band + orange tag 'LEAD CHANGE' + name) that wipe in from an edge.
fix: Replace with a flat strip: solid orange label block ('LEAD', 'GOAL', 'TP1') + dark name block, no blur, no glow, no radius, wipe in from the left at the top-left safe area.

title: Twenty-colour rainbow plus a colour bar on every row
what: Each pilot gets one of 20 saturated colours (blue, yellow, teal, red, violet, pink, lime...) shown as a 4×30 px bar on every board row, on trails, map dots and the course strip; together with the green/red arrows, teal values and orange there are well over 10 accent colours on screen.
why: Broadcasts keep 2–3 accent colours; team colours appear as a tiny chip only where needed. The per-row vertical bar is the same 'accent bar' tic the owner already removed elsewhere.
fix: Drop the .sw bar on rows (the flag already identifies); colour only the selected pilot and the leader on the map, render everyone else in one neutral grey trail; reduce COLS to a muted set used only on hover/selection.

title: Green/red up-down arrows flicker on most rows
what: ▲/▼ in #39D98A/#FF5A5A appear on many rows at once and persist 4 s; in Arrivals the P1 pilot in goal shows a red ▼, and before the gate rows that are merely thermalling show arrows.
why: Stock-ticker arrows are a dashboard cliché; F1 shows a single position-gain marker briefly on the row that just overtook, in the house colour.
fix: Show a change marker only on real overtakes in the race phase, one at a time, as a small orange chevron or '+1' that fades after 2 s; never in pre-start or arrivals.

title: Selected states use the same solid orange as the primary button
what: The control bar has four solid-orange blocks at once (60×, FOLLOW, 2D and BROADCAST) in three rounded segmented-pill groups, so the real call to action does not stand out.
why: The orange should mean 'the one action' (owner rule: buttons solid orange); toggles in broadcast/F1 apps use a white underline or white text on dark.
fix: Keep BROADCAST solid orange; style segmented selections as white text with a 2 px white underline (or white fill, dark text); drop the pill tray background.

title: Two stacked rails with different names, collisions and a default slider
what: The course strip (SSS / Las Gemelas / Tamazula / Goal) sits above a second rail of markers labelled GATE / TP1 / TP2 / 1ST GOAL for the same places; the lead diamond sits on the 'GATE' label, 'RESULT' is struck through by a tick, and the scrubber is a native range input with accent-color.
why: Broadcast timelines are one rail with one naming scheme and custom-drawn thumb and ticks.
fix: Merge into one rail: course strip on top, markers on the same baseline, use the same names (TP1 Las Gemelas), avoid labels under diamonds, draw a custom thin track and square playhead.

title: Waypoint labels collide with each other and with pilot tags
what: 'Amacueca' and 'Goal' print into each other ('AmacuecaGoal'); at the goal pilot tags and gaggle bubbles cover the waypoint label ('Amacue', 'ca') and each other (bubbles 6, 8 and 2 stacked); on phone 'Las Gemelas' and 'Tamazula' are cut by the screen edge.
why: Broadcast maps place labels with leader lines and never let them overlap or get clipped.
fix: Add waypoint labels to the same placement pass as pilot tags (as fixed obstacles), merge Amacueca TP + Goal into one label, keep labels inside the viewport.

title: Goal arrivals flood the feed with repeated rows
what: Arrivals produce 19 near-identical rows 'GOAL X in goal · 1:48:24 · +5:15' where the time is already in the timestamp column; lines wrap so a row starts with '· +2:47'.
why: Broadcast feeds summarise ('5 more in goal: …') and put times in a column, not repeated in prose.
fix: Group arrivals within a minute into one entry; drop the duplicated time from the text; render the gap in a right-aligned column.

title: Template sentences repeat word for word
what: Climb entries all read '<NAME> averages +x.x m/s over two minutes on the leg to Las Gemelas: strongest climb so far.' (seven times in a row in places), and lead changes all '... takes the lead from ..., on the leg to ...'.
why: Repetitive fill-in-the-blank prose is the most obviously generated thing on the page; commentary graphics use short, varied, numbers-first lines.
fix: Write short headline lines ('CASTRO +4.4 m/s · best climb'), vary or drop the clause, and cap climb records to the 2–3 that matter.

title: Seven colours of tag chips and tinted rows
what: Every entry starts with a micro pill tag (START yellow, CLIMB peach, LEAD orange-tint, HIGH blue, TP grey, GOAL teal, RESULT teal) and lead/goal rows get a left-to-right gradient wash.
why: Coloured pill chips + gradient tints are a template pattern; broadcast feeds use a type label in one colour and rely on weight/position.
fix: Use plain bold caps labels in muted grey (orange only for LEAD), no backgrounds; remove the row gradients.

title: Telemetry card is a dashboard widget with dead cells
what: A 14 px-radius frosted card with drop shadow, a 6-cell grid, a mini vario meter and an orange area chart; 'Req. glide' shows '—' almost always, after goal it shows +0.0 m/s, 0 km/h, GOAL, —, — and an empty vario track; the footer 'Climbing in a / thermal' wraps beside helper text.
why: Broadcast pilot cards show 3–4 live numbers in a hard-edged block and hide fields that don't apply.
fix: Square, opaque card; 4 stats max (alt, vario, speed, to goal); replace dead fields with goal time/rank when in goal; drop the vario bar and footer hint; keep the barogram as a thin line without fill.

title: Telemetry card covers the action
what: In follow mode the camera centres the pilot at mid-height but the 300 px card sits bottom-right over the goal area; at arrivals pilot tags ('P8 SPAN…') and trails disappear under the card.
why: Broadcast graphics frame the action in the free area, not behind overlays.
fix: Offset the camera centre to the free area left of/above the card (as already done for phone via M.cy), or dock the card in the side column.

title: Micro-labels on every stat, duplicate and dead stats
what: Every top-bar item has a 9.5 px letter-spaced uppercase label; 'IN GOAL 16 of 20' appears next to 'RACING 4 / IN GOAL 16'; 'HIGHEST PILOT' shows '—' after the finish; the wind is an arrow-in-circle icon.
why: F1/SailGP top bars show a few big numbers with short, readable labels and no repeats; icon-in-circle is generic dashboard iconography.
fix: Keep race clock, leg/arrivals, wind; remove the duplicate RACING/IN GOAL block; hide 'Highest' when not racing; draw the wind as a plain arrow + text; set labels at 11 px with less tracking.

title: 'REPLAY' pill is styled as a live red blinking indicator
what: While playing, the pill says REPLAY but uses the LIVE style: red-tinted glass, red border and a blinking red dot; when finished it switches to the grey 'replay' class with the word FINISHED.
why: Red pulsing dot means live on air; on a replay it is a fake signal. Broadcast replays carry a flat 'REPLAY' tag.
fix: Swap the logic (replay class while playing, no blink), make it a flat square tag, keep red + pulse only for real live data.

title: Panel header wraps and leans on a status dot
what: At Result the header becomes 'LEADERBOARD● OFFICIAL RESULT · BY / SCORE' on two lines with the dot touching the heading; every phase uses a coloured dot + dotted micro-label ('START GAGGLE · BY HEIGHT').
why: Coloured status dots and dot-separated micro labels are template tics; broadcast towers use one short title ('RESULT', 'GOAL ORDER').
fix: Replace with a single phase title (e.g. 'START GAGGLE', 'RACE', 'GOAL ORDER', 'RESULT') in the header itself; drop the dot; keep the header on one line.

title: Names truncated with ellipses
what: Broadcast board shows 'QUINTANILLA…', 'LUEBBERKE…'; on phone 'TAKAT…', 'SPANCE…' and 'FORGO H…' (nation code cut); desktop board 'ANDRELIUN…'.
why: Broadcast graphics use agreed short names (3-letter codes or surname caps) that always fit; ellipses look unfinished.
fix: Give every pilot a fixed TV name (≤10 chars) and 3-letter code; size the board columns to fit them; on phone show the code only.

title: Phone broadcast: lower third clipped and an empty control bar
what: At 390 px the lower third scrolls sideways and cuts 'SPEED 50 km' with TO GOAL off-screen; below it a 70 px bar holds only a white pause button and an icon-only orange square.
why: Phone broadcast graphics are stacked to fit the width; controls auto-hide.
fix: On phone show P/name/alt/vario only (2×2), hide the bottom bar after 3 s (tap to show) and label the exit button.

title: Instruction text and hint chips on the canvas
what: A letter-spaced caps bar 'DRAG TO MOVE · SCROLL OR DOUBLE-CLICK TO ZOOM · SHIFT- OR RIGHT-DRAG…' covers the map for 7 s; the card footer says 'Real track · tap a pilot to follow'; 'EXIT BROADCAST [ESC]' has a kbd chip; timeline markers rely on native title tooltips.
why: On-screen instructions and keycap chips are web-app scaffolding; broadcast surfaces show content only.
fix: Remove the hint bar (or show a single small '?' help), drop the footer hint and kbd chip, replace native titles with a custom hover caption in the timeline style.

title: Broadcast still shows app chrome and two exit buttons
what: In Broadcast the back arrow, sub-line, REPLAY pill, full scrubber, a frosted 'EXIT BROADCAST ESC' button and the orange BROADCAST button (which also exits) are all on screen, plus a frosted 'airtribune' pill bug.
why: A broadcast view is a clean frame: logo bug, clock, tower, lower third. Controls appear on hover.
fix: Hide back arrow, sub-line and scrubber until mouse move; keep one exit control; make the bug a flat logo without a pill.

title: Pilot tags are rounded outlined pills in every pilot colour
what: Map tags are 4 px-radius pills with a 1.2 px border in the pilot's rainbow colour, italic caps; '+6' on a tag means '6 more in this gaggle' but reads like a time gap; gaggle counts sit in white-ringed circles.
why: Broadcast name tags are flat, square, one style (dark block, white name, small position box); cluster counts are written out.
fix: Square, borderless dark tags with a solid position block (orange for P1); write clusters as 'P5 ANDRELIUNAS & 6'; draw gaggles as a plain number without a ring.

title: Peek sheet cuts a row in half; tab labels inconsistent
what: The 150 px peek shows one leaderboard row and half of the next; the Leaderboard tab stacks 'LEADERBOARD / ● BEFORE START' on two lines before the race but inline 'LEADERBOARD ● RACING' later.
why: Sheets snap so rows are whole; tab labels stay fixed.
fix: Set PEEK so it shows exactly 2 rows (head + 2×52), keep the phase out of the tab label (or always one line).

title: Heavy italic everywhere flattens the hierarchy
what: Archivo 800 italic is used for title, positions, names, values, units' parents, panel headings, tags, toast, lower third and board; Inter is mixed in for gaps and sub-lines at 600.
why: SailGP/F1 use italic sparingly (headlines); data is upright condensed with tabular figures, giving clear contrast between names and numbers.
fix: Set numbers upright (Archivo 700, tabular), keep italic for names and section titles only; define a 4-step type scale.

title: Floating map chips repeat what the board and toast say
what: Frosted pills 'TASK 58.7 KM · 3 TPS' and 'FIRST IN GOAL VARGA' sit on the map while the toast says 'VARGA FIRST IN GOAL' and the board shows the same; three statements of one fact.
why: Each fact once; frosted floating chips are a template pattern.
fix: Drop the leader chip; move task distance into the top bar sub-line (already there) and remove the chips.

title: Value column changes meaning without saying so
what: Under 'FLOWN' finished pilots show 'GOAL' in teal; the broadcast board mixes '994 pts' for P1 with times '1:44:15' for the rest; the feed says 993.5 pts while the board rounds to 994.
why: Timing graphics keep one unit per column and identical numbers everywhere.
fix: Show the goal time under a 'TIME' header once pilots are in goal; in the broadcast board show points for all rows (or times for all); use one rounding.

title: 3D tilt stretches screen labels
what: With 3D on, labels and tags are drawn in the tilted SVG, so near ones grow ('P1 TAKATS +2' doubles), far ones shrink, and the dark text halo gets thick and blurry.
why: Broadcast 3D maps keep labels screen-aligned at constant size.
fix: Move labels/tags to a separate untilted overlay layer and project their anchor points through the same perspective.

title: Gap column digits are proportional
what: The GAP column is Inter 600 without tabular figures (computed font-variant-numeric: normal; '1111' 20 px vs '8888' 31 px), so right-aligned gaps don't line up and jitter as they change.
why: Timing columns always use tabular figures.
fix: Add font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums to .row .g (and to elements whose font shorthand resets .num, e.g. .t-big/.t-mid).

title: Keyboard shortcuts stop working after clicking a control
what: After clicking 2D/3D or any button, focus stays on it (orange focus ring shown) and 'B' (broadcast) and Space (play) do nothing because the handlers require e.target === document.body.
why: A real bug; broadcast tools keep shortcuts global.
fix: Allow shortcuts when the target is a button (ignore only inputs/textareas), or blur buttons after pointer clicks.
